title: Heavenly Secrets Fourth
next_chapter_hook: Far deep within the Holy Sect's forbidden grounds, a young maiden imprisoned for many years abruptly opened her eyes. She sensed the familiar aura transmitted from the depths of her bloodline—Brother, have you finally begun your move?

text.content: Dawn was just breaking, the mist on the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain had yet to dissipate. Chen Ji stood before the rift prophesied in the omen, his black robes billowing in the mountain wind. His fingers gently brushed against the Tianji Record Fragment, feeling the faint pulse emanating from within—the premonition that the fourth page was about to awaken. Master Mo's aged voice resonated in his Mental Sea, carrying an undeniable excitement: 'Master, you have finally found the key.'

Chen Ji did not turn around, his gaze still fixed on the depths of the rift. There, faintly visible, were scattered golden fragments like torn stars, emanating an ancient and mysterious aura. 'The conditions for the fourth page's manifestation, Master Mo, there's no need to hide them.' His voice was calm, betraying no emotional fluctuation. 'Since I stand here, you should tell me.' The remnant soul guardian's sigh rang out: 'Master is indeed perceptive. Gathering the three ancient relics is required for the fourth page of the Tianji Record to manifest—and these three relics are precisely the final arrangement that Senior Chen Xuan scattered across the mortal realm.'

dialogue.content: 'The first, the Dragon Vein Core, sealed beneath the Dragon Palace ruins in the depths of the Eastern Sea.' Master Mo's voice carried weight and formality. 'The second, a fragment of destiny hidden within the temporal-spatial rift, located at the site of the catastrophe erased by the Heavenly Dao thirty years ago. The third...' He paused. 'The Heavenly Secrets Palace's highest level, the final test left behind by Senior Chen Xuan himself.'

text.content: Chen Ji finally turned around, the corner of his mouth slightly raised in a cold, razor-sharp smile. 'The Dragon Palace ruins are guarded by the Xuanwu Sect, the temporal-spatial rift is a Heavenly Dao forbidden zone, and the Heavenly Secrets Palace is that old fox Ling Yuan's territory.' He paced slowly, his boots crunching against the gravel. 'Senior Chen Xuan certainly had good plans, leaving the three most difficult puzzle pieces for his descendants.' Master Mo fell silent for a moment before speaking: 'The power of the fourth page surpasses the previous three—it can temporarily rewrite the clauses of the Contract of Fate.'

dialogue.content: Rewrite the Contract of Fate? Chen Ji's footsteps came to an abrupt halt, a gleam of sharpness flickering in his eyes. Heavenly Fate values, karmic backlash, the Heavenly Dao's chess game... all the dead ends that had troubled him might find their answer on this page. His breathing quickened momentarily before he suppressed his emotions, returning to his unruffled demeanor. 'Interesting.' He uttered two words indifferently. 'Since that's the case, these three relics, I must obtain all of them before Chapter Seven Hundred.'

text.content: Just then, the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly quivered violently, and a blurred image flashed before Chen Ji's eyes—a girl bound by chains in the darkness, her features bearing a seventy percent resemblance to Chen Nian from his memory. The girl's lips moved slightly, seeming to speak, but the image was too blurry to hear clearly. 'Nian'er...' Chen Ji murmured, his pupils contracting sharply. This was the first time since Chen Nian was taken by the Holy Sect that the Tianji Record had proactively shown him an image related to her. Master Mo's voice sounded again: 'Master, once the fourth page manifests, perhaps it will allow you to see the causalities obscured by Heavenly Fate—including your sister's whereabouts.'

choice.prompt: The three ancient relics are scattered across the world, each one perilous beyond measure. Chen Ji must collect them concurrently within the feigned death plan. Which route would best enable him to achieve his goal before Chapter Seven Hundred?

choices.description: The Dragon Vein Core is sealed at the deepest level, but if one can take advantage of the conflict between Han Lie and the Xuanwu Sect, it can be seized in the chaos. High risk, clear rewards.
choices.visible_cost: Requires spending 30 Heavenly Fate points for precise foresight
choices.visible_reward: The Dragon Vein Core can strengthen the Tianji Record's perception of Dragon Vein spiritual energy, bringing one closer to rewriting fate
choices.risk_hint: Xuanwu Sect's number one genius Han Lie guards the ruins; direct confrontation means certain defeat

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, his fingers gently touching the Tianji Record. Golden text appeared before him, and he witnessed an image of Han Lie being ambushed outside the Dragon Palace Ruins three days later—an excellent opportunity indeed. 'Killing with borrowed knives, and the knives belong to the Heavenly Dao's forbidden zone.' He opened his eyes, a cold smile forming at the corner of his mouth. 'This suits me perfectly.'

choices.description: The Fate Fragment is hidden within the ruins of the catastrophe thirty years ago. Though the temporal-spatial disorder is extremely dangerous, Ye Qing's Demonic Path mist can conceal one's presence.
choices.visible_cost: Requires Ye Qing's full cooperation, which would expose the secret dealings between the Demonic Path and Tianqing Sect
choices.visible_reward: The Fate Fragment can stabilize the Tianji Record's foresight ability, reducing the occurrence of blurred images
choices.risk_hint: Ancient fierce beasts inhabit the temporal rift; a single misstep could lead to being lost forever

text.content: Chen Ji retrieved a black transmission talisman from his sleeve, whispering a few words. After a moment, Ye Qing's voice came through the talisman, carrying a hint of surprise: 'You've finally come to your senses? The temporal rift is no trivial matter.' Chen Ji said coolly: 'With your Demonic Path mist, even if I wanted to die, it would be difficult.' A soft laugh came from the talisman: 'Chen Ji, I like hearing you say that.'

choices.text: Seizing Treasure from the Heavenly Secrets Palace
choices.description: That old fox Ling Yuan guards the highest level, making it the most dangerous. However, Chen Ji happens to possess a relic from Chen Xuan, which might open the seals.
choices.visible_cost: Requires entering Ling Yuan's territory; if discovered, all previous efforts would be wasted
choices.visible_reward: The Heavenly Secrets Palace relic can directly unlock some of the fourth page's functions without needing to gather all three relics
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan and Chen Xuan share old grudges; upon seeing Chen Xuan's remains, he will surely go mad

text.content: Chen Ji drew an ancient jade pendant from his chest—a token entrusted to him by Chen Xuan on his deathbed. On the pendant was carved a small character 'Ji', matching the handwriting on the Tianji Record Fragment exactly. 'That old fool Ling Yuan has been dreaming of getting his hands on this thing.' He held the jade pendant in his palm, feeling the lingering warmth within. 'Unfortunately, he will never know the true use of this object.'

choices.description: Initiate all three lines simultaneously, preventing the enemy from determining the true target. However, the consumption is enormous and requires multi-party cooperation.
choices.visible_cost: Heavenly Fate consumption doubles, and perfect execution of every chess move is required
choices.visible_reward: As long as any single line succeeds, key information can be obtained, making subsequent collection much easier
choices.risk_hint: If any one of the three lines is exposed, the feigned death plan will completely collapse

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, golden characters on the Tianji Record flashing madly. Three timelines unfolded in his mind in parallel, like three chess games being played simultaneously. Han Lie trapped in Dragon Palace ruins, Ye Qing穿梭于时空裂隙的身影, Ling Yuan's furious face in Tianji Palace—all images intertwined, forming a vast and intricate web. 'This is how it should be.' He opened his eyes, his gaze revealing bottomless cold light. 'If we're going to play, let's play big.'

The mountain wind suddenly turned biting. Chen Ji raised his head toward the direction of Tianqing Sect Main Peak. There, shrouded in clouds and mist, a majestic palace could be faintly seen—Tianji Palace, the forbidden grounds of Tianqing Sect and the residence of Elder Ling Yuan. His gaze lingered in that direction for a moment before withdrawing. 'The feigned death plan must be initiated in three days.' He murmured to himself. 'By then, the Sect Competition will bring all major forces together—truly the perfect timing.'

dialogue.content: 'Han Lie will challenge the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow during the Competition, causing inevitable chaos in Tianqing Sect.' Chen Ji spoke while deducing countless possibilities in his mind. 'And at that time, I will 'die'—die at just the right moment, making everyone believe I was an innocent victim.' Mo Xiansheng praised: 'Master's strategy of the cicada escaping its shell is truly masterful.' Chen Ji coldly smiled: 'The real show is yet to come.' He turned and walked toward the downhill path, his black figure gradually disappearing into the morning mist, leaving only a low murmur echoing in the wind: 'Ling Yuan, wait for me. When I gather the three artifacts, it will be time to settle accounts with you.'

text.content: Meanwhile, deep within the Holy Sect's forbidden grounds. In a dim stone chamber, the clanking of iron chains broke the long silence. Chen Nian abruptly opened her eyes, sensing a familiar aura penetrating the layers of prohibitions, touching the depths of her bloodline. It was brother's aura—the brother she had believed long dead. 'Ji-ge...' Her lips trembled slightly, eyes reddening. For ten years, she had been imprisoned here, used as a Heavenly Fate Lock Key, enduring unimaginable suffering. Yet she never gave up hope, for she believed Ji-ge would definitely come to rescue her. 'You've finally begun to act.' Her voice was hoarse yet firm. 'This time, I will no longer sit and wait for death.'

Chen Nian took a deep breath and slowly closed her eyes. Her hands formed a strange magical seal, and the runes on the iron chains began to flash violently. The core of the Holy Sect's prohibition封印ed her bloodline power, but what if this force could be briefly released? 'Brother, you're searching for the three ancient artifacts, aren't you?' She silently recited in her heart. 'I can sense... one of them is right by my side.' She opened her eyes, a resolute light flickering in her gaze. Ten years had passed, and she finally found an opportunity to escape. And this time, she was no longer the helpless little girl—she was the Heavenly Fate Lock Key, the key to unlock fate's chains. Though the Holy Sect's prohibition was powerful, it also became her eyes to perceive the outside world. And right now, she clearly sensed: brother was weaving a grand net that would sweep across the world.

choice.prompt: Chen Ji is meticulously arranging the three-line operation, while Chen Nian in the Holy Sect also begins attempting to break free from her chains. At this critical moment, Chen Ji faces a key decision:

choices.text: Transmit a coded signal to Chen Nian
choices.description: Utilize the power of the Tianji Record Fragment to send Chen Nian a bloodline message only she can understand, preparing her to become an internal collaborator.
choices.visible_cost: Consumes 15 Heavenly Fate points, and the information may be intercepted by the Eyes of Heavenly Dao
choices.visible_reward: Chen Nian will prepare in advance and become an internal collaborator at the critical moment
choices.risk_hint: The Eyes of Heavenly Dao have been constantly monitoring any fluctuations of the Tianji Record

text.content: Chen Ji pressed his palm onto the Tianji Record, and a concealed bloodline mark traveled through ethereal connections, penetrating thousands of miles. In the stone chamber, Chen Nian suddenly clutched her chest, her eyes instantly moistening. 'Ji-ge...' she murmured. 'You are indeed still alive.' Within the mark were only four characters, yet they made her truly smile for the first time in ten years: Wait for the opportunity.

choices.description: Since Chen Nian can sense me, it means the timing is near. No need to risk transmitting information, proceed with the original plan.
choices.visible_cost: Miss the optimal window for cooperation with Chen Nian
choices.visible_reward: The feigned death plan and artifact collection can proceed smoothly
choices.risk_hint: Chen Nian may act rashly without knowledge of the situation

text.content: Chen Ji withdrew his palm, a hint of tenderness flickering in his eyes. Nian-er, since you can sense me,

Three days later, the Sect Competition arrived as scheduled. The Tianqing Sect Martial Arena was crowded with people, elite disciples from the three major sects gathered in one place, and the air was filled with tension and excitement. On the high platform, Ling Yuan sat in the main seat, his face stern, but his gaze kept sweeping toward a corner of the crowd—where an unremarkable servant disciple stood, none other than Chen Ji. 'Today, any sect may freely issue challenges.' Ling Yuan's voice echoed across the arena, 'The victor shall receive a volume of sect secret manuals, while the defeated...' He paused, 'shall bear the consequences themselves.'

dialogue.content: Before his words even faded, a domineering voice rang out across the entire arena: 'No need to wait any longer! I issue my challenge!' Han Lie burst forth from the Xuanwu Sect crowd, like a raging wild beast, his gaze fixed directly on Su Qingyao atop the high platform. 'The Inner Sect Senior Fellow of Tianqing Sect, do you dare fight me?' The entire arena erupted in uproar. Su Qingyao's face was cold as frost, and just as she was about to speak, she saw Chen Ji slowly walking out from the crowd. 'Han Senior Brother, what imposing authority.' His voice wasn't loud, yet it clearly reached everyone's ears. 'But before challenging the Inner Sect Senior Fellow, shouldn't you first get past me?' All eyes turned to him, filled with disbelief—a servant disciple actually daring to challenge the number one genius of Xuanwu Sect?

choice.prompt: Chen Ji, as a servant disciple, publicly challenging Han Lie caused an uproar throughout the arena. This move was a crucial step in his faked death plan, but the approach could differ:

choices.text: Feigning weakness to lure the enemy
choices.description: Deliberately performing weakly to induce Han Lie's contempt, creating a greater contrast for the later reversal.
choices.visible_cost: Will need to withstand several attacks from Han Lie, may sustain injuries
choices.visible_reward: The entire arena will witness the shocking scene of atrash's reversal, Han Lie's reputation will be ruined
choices.risk_hint: If Han Lie strikes too heavily, it might backfire

text.content: Chen Ji deliberately stumbled backward two steps, putting on a panicked appearance. Han Lie burst into laughter upon seeing this: 'You trash dares to challenge me?' He threw a punch, his momentum stunning. Chen Ji was struck, his body flying backward, blood spattering everywhere. 'Enough!' Su Qingyao was about to intervene when she saw Chen Ji rise from the ground, wipe the blood from his lips, and a strange smile curve his lips—it was the gaze of a hunter looking at prey.

choices.description: Taking advantage of Han Lie's contempt, directly revealing part of his strength for a swift victory to shock the entire arena.
choices.visible_cost: Revealing strength may alert Ling Yuan
choices.visible_reward: Han Lie suffers an immediate defeat, Chen Ji's prestige soars
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan may see through the trick from this single strike

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze instantly turned sharp as a blade. His figure blurred, splitting into three afterimages as he attacked Han Lie simultaneously. This move was impossibly fast—even Han Lie couldn't react in time. 'Bang!' The muffled sound echoed as the number one genius of Xuanwu Sect was knocked back ten steps in a single strike, the entire arena falling into dead silence. 'You...' Han Lie clutched his chest, his face full of disbelief. 'You're notrash!' Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back, his black hair fluttering in the wind, his cold smile growing more pronounced: 'Who said I was atrash?'

At this moment, the sky suddenly changed color. A massive rift tore open from the horizon, golden light pouring from the crack, illuminating the entire Martial Arena. 'This is...' Everyone looked up, their faces filled with shock and terror. Ling Yuan's expression drastically changed as he abruptly stood: 'The Heavenly Forbidden Land... why would it open here?' Chen Ji gazed at that rift, a gleam flashing in his eyes. He knew this was the precursor to the fourth page of the Tianji Record manifesting—one of the three ancient relics was responding to his call. 'Interesting.' He murmured softly. 'It seems the plan will proceed even better than anticipated.'

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan's voice echoed throughout the arena: 'Everyone evacuate immediately! This is the entrance to the Heavenly Forbidden Land, no one shall approach!' However, while everyone was in chaos, Chen Ji silently moved toward the rift. Su Qingyao noticed his movement, a hint of confusion flickering in her eyes: 'Chen Ji, where are you going?' Chen Ji glanced back at her, that gaze complex and profound, making her heart inexplicably tremble. 'To do what I must.' After he spoke, his figure vanished into the chaotic crowd, leaving only words drifting in the wind: 'Qingyao, if I don't return... remember to take care of the Tianqing Sect for me.'

text.content: Su Qingyao stood frozen in place, a wave of inexplicable unease flooding her heart. She wanted to pursue, but was blocked by the chaotic crowd. By the time she finally carved a path through, Chen Ji had long vanished. Meanwhile, a thunderous roar echoed from within the rift, a terrifying aura spreading outward. 'It's an ancient fierce beast!' Someone screamed in terror. 'Run!' The entire Martial Arena descended into complete chaos. Yet Chen Ji's figure had already appeared at the edge of the rift, his black robes billowing in the golden light. Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded in his ear: 'Master, the Fate Fragment lies deep within the rift. But guarding it is an ancient fierce beast that even Heaven and Earth cannot destroy.' Chen Ji took a deep breath, stepping into that rift leading to the unknown: 'Since that's the case, let it witness what the Tianji Record can do.'

Inside the rift was a twisted space-time, golden and black energies intertwining to form a bizarre yet magnificent scene. Chen Ji moved through it, the Tianji Record Fragment in his palm emitting a faint glow, guiding his way. In the distance, a massive silhouette coiled in the void—a beast covered entirely in golden scales, its body as immense as a mountain, its vertical pupils coldly staring at him. 'Another one seeking death.' The beast spoke, its voice rumbling through space-time. 'How many years has it been? Finally someone dares to enter my territory.' Chen Ji stood unruffled, bowing slightly: 'Junior Chen Ji, specifically to borrow the Fate Fragment.' The beast's enormous pupils flickered with amusement: 'Borrow? Do you know the price of this thing?'

dialogue.content: Chen Ji stared directly into those massive vertical pupils, his expression calm: 'I would be honored to hear the details.' The beast slowly rose to its feet, golden scales refracting countless lights within the twisted space-time: 'Thirty years ago, someone like you also barged in here, wanting to take the Fate Fragment.' Its voice turned cold and menacing. 'His name was Chen Xuan—your ancestor, I presume?' Chen Ji's heart jolted, but his face remained impassive: 'And so?' The beast let out a low, chilling laugh: 'He failed. I sealed him here, becoming part of the Fate Fragment. If you want to take it, you must endure his fate—forever trapped here.' Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, then slowly spoke: 'What if I refuse?' The beast's vertical pupils abruptly contracted: 'Then I'll seal you too! Let your entire Chen family reunite here forever!'

text.content: A slight smile curved Chen Ji's lips, that grin carrying a hint of mockery: 'Reunion? That's a fresh way of putting it.' He raised the Tianji Record in his hand, golden characters slowly emerging on the fragment. 'But it seems Senior has forgotten one thing.' The beast frowned: 'What thing?' Chen Ji's voice turned ice-cold: 'Senior Chen Xuan chose to stay behind voluntarily back then, specifically to wait for the day when his descendant would come here with the Tianji Record.' He lifted the fragment high, golden light suddenly blazing brilliantly. 'He said—when the moment ripens, a Chen family descendant will come to claim what belongs to him. And now, the time has come.' The beast's pupils violently contracted, feeling a suppression from deep within the bloodline—that was the power of fate, the power of the Tianji Record. 'You...' Its voice trembled for the first time.

At this moment, an aged and familiar voice echoed from the depths of the void: 'Ji'er, you've finally arrived.' Chen Ji's entire body trembled—that was Chen Xuan's voice! Golden light gathered into a虚幻 figure, precisely resembling Chen Xuan. The beast let out a terrified roar: 'Impossible! You were clearly devoured by me!' Chen Xuan's figure smiled gently: 'Devoured? What I devoured was merely your remnant consciousness left in the outside world. The true me has been waiting in the Tianji Record for this moment.' He looked at Chen Ji, eyes full of gratification. 'You're even more impressive than I anticipated. Entrusting you with the Tianji Record, I'm at ease.' Chen Ji took a deep breath, bowing solemnly: 'Descendant Chen Ji shall certainly fulfill our ancestor's entrustment.'

Chen Xuan's figure slowly dissipated, turning into golden light that merged into the Tianji Record. The beast, having lost its suppressing force, its massive body began to崩解, letting out pain-filled screams. 'No... this is impossible... I waited three thousand years...' Its voice gradually faded, ultimately disappearing completely within the twisted space-time. And in its place, a fragment emanating a faint blue glow slowly drifted down, landing in Chen Ji's palm—the Fate Fragment, found! The Tianji Record Fragment violently trembled, a stream of information flooding into Chen Ji's mind: 'First ancient relic acquisition complete. Second relic, the Dragon Vein Core, location locked. Third relic, highest floor of the Tianji Palace, accessible in three days. Master, the fourth page's manifestation requires one final step—find your sister Chen Nian, she's the Heavenly Fate Lock Key, also the key to opening the chains of destiny.'

Chen Ji held the Fate Fragment, feeling the vast power contained within it. He looked up toward the exit of the space-time rift, a faint smile appearing on his lips. The faked death plan had succeeded halfway—now everyone believed he died in the chaos when the Heavenly Forbidden Land opened, including that old fox Ling Yuan. 'Excellent.' He murmured softly. 'Now, it's your turn.' He turned toward the exit, his black figure appearing exceptionally lonely yet resolute within the golden light. Among the three ancient relics, he had already obtained the first. And Chen Nian in the Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds, at this moment, sensed the joy from deep within her bloodline, a relieved smile appearing on her face. 'Ji-gege, you did it.' She murmured. 'Now, it's my turn.' Her hands formed hand seals again, this time not for perception, but for—breaking free from the chains.
